title: Reward Top K Students
statement:
Each report gives a student 3 points for every positive feedback word and subtracts 1 for every negative feedback word. Return the IDs of the top `k` students ordered by score descending, then ID ascending.

## Examples

```text
Input: positive_feedback = ["smart","brilliant","studious"], negative_feedback = ["not"], report = ["this student is studious","the student is smart"], student_id = [1,2], k = 2
Output: [1,2]
```

```text
Input: positive_feedback = ["smart","brilliant","studious"], negative_feedback = ["not"], report = ["this student is not studious","the student is smart"], student_id = [1,2], k = 2
Output: [2,1]
```

## Constraints

- Positive and negative vocabularies contain lowercase words and do not overlap
- `report.length == student_id.length`, with 1..10^4 students
- Reports contain lowercase words separated by single spaces
- Student IDs are unique positive integers; `1 <= k <= number of reports`
